prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 2D browser-game hurt animation spritesheet.
Input image 1 is the edit target: a transparent 8-slot canvas with the approved SOIL BOAR in the first slot. Input image 2 is the same approved boar seed enlarged for identity. Input image 3 is ONLY the animation/emotion reference: the green sprout bean hurt sheet; do not copy that character or its rendering style.
Create the COMPLETE eight-frame animation strip in ONE coherent edit. Exactly EIGHT complete separate boars in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of eight evenly spaced equal slots, reading left to right. Large empty transparent whitespace above and below the row is fine. Never wrap into two rows. No captions, no grid lines, no extra poses. All eight boars the same facing left three-quarter camera, same scale and anatomy, brown fur, tan muzzle, tusks, dark hoof shapes, leafy moss patches and curved tail; retain the seed's richly painted non-pixel game-art style, lighting, palette and proportions. Do not simplify to a cartoon or pixel art.
Action is PAINFUL HIT REACTION, modeled on the sprout bean: snap to a visibly recoiled pose within the first 110 ms, squeeze eyes firmly SHUT in pain, hold that hurt pose for 400ms, then recover. This must be newly drawn changing expressions AND articulated body poses, with a clearly readable backward lean and braced limbs, not eight nearly identical idle copies and not a tiny head sway. The boar has been hit from its front-left; it recoils toward its rear-right. Its head and heavy shoulder lift and recoil, neck compresses, knees flex as feet brace at the same floor level. The hooves stay at the same ground baseline and do not walk. No root travel, no new view, no size changes. Keep all fur, tusks, moss and tail consistent. Let ears fold back and tail follow naturally.
Precisely these eight cels left to right:
0: exact calm seed neutral, eyes open, current planted stance.
1: sudden hit onset, eyelids halfway closing, head beginning to pull up and back and shoulder bracing.
2: eyes squeezed completely shut, brows compressed in pain, head and shoulder sharply recoiling, body visibly leaning backward, legs braced.
3: strongest hurt key, both eyes still tightly closed, mouth/muzzle tensed in pain, clear rearward lean with planted feet. This cel will hold 400ms. Keep it recognizably the same boar, not an attack.
4: eyes still closed, lower the head and shoulder partway back toward neutral, maintain braced anatomy.
5: eyelids half open, recovering torso and legs, ears and tail lag slightly.
6: almost neutral open eyes, final settle of ears and tail.
7: exact seed neutral again, matching cel0 and the approved seed closely.
Eyes must show actual drawn closed eyelids in cels2,3,4, not open eyeballs. No cartoon X eyes, stars, tears, exclamation symbols, fear pose, open-mouthed roar, attack lunge, damage effects, blood, scenery, ground shadow or text. Every complete boar fits inside its own slot with clear transparent gaps, no clipping or touching neighbors. Genuine alpha-transparent background. Keep a coherent stable character size and grounded floor anchor across the entire eight-cel strip.
